mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which may impair renal clearance of latanoprost metabolites and potentially compromise ocular perfusion pressure.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and intraocular pressure closely; ensure adequate hydration and consider alternative antifungal agents if possible; coordinate with ophthalmology if IOP changes occur.
